issue.title: test_mounted_clan_fold_chords_zoom_and_patch_isolation fails under just check's parallel test-scoped lane, passes in isolation
issue.description: Discovered while landing epic sase-vk (memory webs get their own agent-instruction section). The failing node is TUI agents-panel fold behavior, entirely unrelated to the epic's docs/memory-vocabulary work — the reporting phase (sase-vk.3) touched only docs/, memory templates, glossary strands, and generated agent instruction files, never TUI agents-panel fold code.

task_type_fields.evidence: Failed once during a `just check` run whose test-scoped lane ran in parallel; reran the same node in isolation on the same unchanged tree and it passed cleanly. One fail / one pass observed, so the fail rate is not yet characterized. The failure appeared only under the parallel lane, matching the shape of the other parallel-lane flake beads filed over the last week (sase-ty, sase-u0, sase-u1, sase-t3). Observed 2026-08-30 by phase agent sase-vk.3 and recorded as PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP note 3 on that phase bead.

payload.description: Both are ACE TUI agents-pane tests that fail only under the parallel lane and pass in isolation; likely the same mount/settle race rather than two independent defects.

evidence.note: Independent reproduction on 2026-09-05 while landing an unrelated split of src/sase/bead/conflict_resolver.py into multiple files (no TUI code touched). just check's parallel test-scoped lane failed this node; an isolated pytest rerun of the same node on the same unchanged tree passed. Matches the prior fails-parallel/passes-isolated pattern exactly.
